content: Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina mai
Ga muliyega ꞌemasula ꞌana esana Penitikosi ꞌana ꞌasiyata ꞌenaya Yesu ꞌana toemisao maiboꞌadi niꞌatu sideli egogonama,
ga anuwaya simiyamiya, ta galewega ꞌebweu dudu ꞌatuwa wediliya sinabwana sinonona, ga ꞌidi anuwa solana nigeya sawesawenaya be ꞌebweu wate toꞌase sida nono,
ta ꞌebweu yage siꞌitena ꞌana ꞌita kaiwe sabesabeluluna nadigega, ga ꞌenega sabelulu nidi debadiya sitowa ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna.
ꞌEnega maiboꞌadi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiloemaedi, ta sieꞌale ga mali ꞌenana be mali ꞌenana ꞌediyega sionaona, nate Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina waiwaiyega.
Tuta gote ꞌenaya totapwalolo me Yudia mali esenega be mali esenega niꞌatu simai, ga Yelusalema ꞌena simiyami,
ga dudu nina sinononaya ta sideli egogonama, manuna maiboꞌadi taudi ꞌenadiyega ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ona sinonona, ꞌenega nuwadi ꞌiowana sinabwana,
ga sigwae, “Mwaꞌadega, taudi toona nidi maiboꞌadi me Galili aga?
Ta mwaꞌadega ga ꞌenega maiboꞌada tauda ꞌenadega sionaona,
ꞌenana nidi nate Palitia, be Midia, be Elama, be Mesopotemia ꞌana tomiyanao, be Yudia, be Kapadosia, be Ponito, be Esia, be
Piligia, be Pamipilia, be Itipita, be Libia senanao nidi Sailini solanaya simiyami, be taudi Lomega simai, ꞌaidi me Yudia, ta ꞌaidi nigeya me Yudia ta esi ꞌida tapwalolo ꞌena sitagwaledi maꞌediyao,
be wate me Kiliti be me Alebia, ta maiboꞌada tauda ꞌenada dumadumadi be dumadumadi ꞌediyega ꞌidi ꞌawagwae Yaubada ꞌina guinuwao waiwaidi manuna sionaona.”
ꞌEnega maiboꞌadi ma idi nuwaowana taudimo ꞌediya sigwaegwae, “Toꞌase ꞌalena ga ꞌidi guinuwa gete nadigega?”
Ta saꞌi gosediyao ꞌaidi sigwae, “Nai bwasi waiwaiyega siekabaleya.”
Ta Pita gosenao site ilebeni maꞌenao sitoolo, ga Pita ꞌieꞌale ga ꞌediya ꞌiloguguya, ꞌigwae, “ꞌOmi me Yudia be Yelusalema ꞌana tomiyanao maiboꞌami ꞌigu ona wada nono, be wada nuwasabwalena,
ꞌaene ꞌima guinuwa gete nigeya bwasi waiwaiyega, manuna maꞌetamo gonagona, nigeya numa ekabaleya ꞌana tuta.
Ta esi yage gete lowa palopita Yoeli ꞌigimi simanena, ꞌiona,

‘Yaubada ꞌina simana gete nadigega ꞌigwae, “Maꞌetamo tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losalowa ꞌenaya, yaluyaluwagu yada ꞌetosiwa tomota maiboꞌadi ꞌediya, be natumiyao meꞌolotodi nai mewainedi sida loguguya, be ꞌimi tubuwauyao sida ꞌenomataꞌitaꞌita, ta ꞌimi ꞌinapwanao sida madawala.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tuta gote ꞌena yaluyaluwagu yada siwa ꞌigu toguinuwa meꞌolotodi be mewainedi ꞌediya, be manugu sida loguguya.
Be ꞌigu guinuwao ꞌebe nuwaowana yada eꞌitaedi galewaya tomota ꞌediya, be wate edeedede bada baleꞌuya, nadigega lala be kaiwe sabelulu be bwawa,
be sinala ꞌida guguyoi, be nawalae ꞌana ꞌita ꞌida elala, be muliyega ꞌInapwana ꞌina ꞌasiyata ꞌebe matauta ꞌida apwesa.
ꞌEnega ꞌabo yaisigedi ꞌInapwana ꞌana esanega sibwabwau ꞌenaya, ꞌida ꞌetoseyedi tuga.” ’ ”

Pita wate ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Me Isileli ꞌomi ona gete wada nono, Yesu tauna goma Nasaleta manuna. Yesu nina matamiya Yaubada ꞌieꞌitaena ꞌaene tauna ꞌina toguinuwa nina, manuna Yesu ꞌina guinuwa waiwaidi ta ꞌebe nuwaowana, Yaubada ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌiguinuwedi, ta wamwalamwalatonidi manuna gamwagamwanimiya ꞌiguinuwedi.
Yaubada lowaenei Yesu nina manuna ꞌiloina, ga toꞌase baleꞌuya ꞌida loba Yaubada ꞌigimi mwalatonina, ta ꞌomi wasipupuyena, ga ꞌimi loinega tomota toꞌumalidi kelose ꞌenaya siloemwawasina.
Ta Yaubada mwawasa ꞌina sena mwauna ꞌenega ꞌiꞌetoseyena, ga ꞌigietoolo limena, manuna nigeya sawesawenaya mwawasa ꞌina senaya ꞌimiyaataya.
Gete manuna lowa Debida Yesu ꞌina ona ꞌigimi simanena, ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌInapwana yaꞌitena mataguya ꞌimiyaataya, ta ꞌataiguya ꞌimiyami, ta ꞌigiewaiwaiyegu be geyaꞌabo yaneeneta.
ꞌEnega yagwausowala sinabwana ta yatuputupuna, be yanuwayaina ꞌaene geyaꞌabo bwalagu ꞌitoꞌutoꞌumali.
ꞌAboꞌagu ꞌimu tai esiesinuwagu, ꞌenega geyaꞌabo yaluyaluwagu ꞌusaꞌusaꞌu ataya tomwawasao ꞌidi ꞌasaya, nai bwalagu wate ꞌimwaulu.
Ta esi yawasi boboꞌana ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌueꞌitaena ꞌeguya. ꞌEnega matamuya ꞌuda giegwausowala ataegu.’ ”
Ta Pita wate ꞌigwae, “Tasigwao, ona gete nigeya tubuda Debida manuna, manuna Debida nina tamwalatonina ꞌaene lowaenei ꞌimwawasa ga sisaꞌu ꞌaliꞌaliyena, ta gete tuga ꞌana ꞌaliꞌali nina bada ꞌimiyami.
Ta Debida nina palopita ꞌebweu, ga Yaubada ꞌina onaupaupa waiwaina ꞌenaya ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisina ꞌaene maꞌetamo Debida tubuna ꞌebweuna Debida nina ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌida ꞌewa Yaubada ꞌenega.
ꞌEnega Toꞌetoseyana nina ꞌina toololimana ꞌigimi mwalatonina, ga ꞌieonena ꞌaene geyaꞌabo tomwawasao yaluyaluwadi ꞌidi ꞌasa ꞌena ꞌimiyamiya ataya, ta wate bwalana geyaꞌabo ꞌimwaumwaulu.
“Gete Yesu nina niꞌatu mwawasega Yaubada ꞌigietoolo limena, ga ꞌaboꞌama maiboꞌama ꞌaꞌitena.

ꞌEnega Yaubada ꞌigituꞌeyena ga tauna ꞌatainaya ꞌimiyami, ga tauna Yaluyaluwa Tabu nina Yaubada lowa ꞌiona upaupaena, ta gete tuga niꞌatu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌema, ꞌenega guinuwa gete waꞌitaꞌitadi ta wanononodi, tauna ꞌenega simai.
“Manuna Debida nigeya tauna ꞌina tuꞌe galewaya manuna ꞌiona, ta Yesu esi manuna ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, ‘Yaubada niꞌatu ꞌiona ꞌigu ꞌInapwana ꞌena, “ꞌAtaiguya ꞌuda miyatowa
be ꞌana laba tuta nina ꞌamu talauwalao yasaꞌu ebusiyedi ꞌaeyo ꞌana ꞌebesaꞌu ꞌena.” ’
“Gete manuna me Isileli maiboꞌami wada mwalatoni ꞌaiꞌaili ꞌaene Yaubada Yesu niꞌatu ꞌiꞌawa ꞌInapwanaena be tauna Toꞌetoseyana, tauna Yesu nina niꞌatu wagiekelosena.”
Tomota nidi Pita ꞌina ona gete niꞌatu sinonona, ga manuna sinuwanuwa sinabwana, ga Pita magosenao ꞌediya sienaida, sigwae, “Tasimao, niꞌatu ꞌaloegesi. Mwaꞌadega ꞌada guinuwaꞌesa?”

ꞌEnega Pita ꞌigwae, “ꞌImi guinuwa toꞌumalina ꞌediyega wada nuwaꞌebuni, be maiboꞌami Toꞌetoseyana Yesu ꞌana esanega ꞌada giebapitaisoemi, be ꞌimi toꞌumalinao ꞌida nuwataudi, be wate Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌemi.
Manuna Yaubada ꞌina onaupaupa nina ꞌaene ꞌomi manumi, be natumiyao wate manudi, be taudi ꞌedasolaya simiyami manudi, yaisigedi taudi Yaubada ꞌibwauyedi ꞌena.”
Ta Pita ꞌina ona be ꞌina loguguya yauna wate ꞌediyega ꞌisimana, ga ꞌigwae, “Gosegwao, ꞌepata gete toꞌumalina ꞌenega waꞌetoseyemi.”
ꞌEnega ꞌasiyata nina ꞌena ꞌaina tomota Pita ꞌina ona sinonona ga sibapitaiso, ta ꞌadi yau nadigega ꞌetoi tausani,
ga sitagwala ꞌaiꞌailedi tosimanao nidi ꞌidi eꞌitao ꞌediya, ta siegosigosiyana ꞌaiꞌailedi, ta siꞌeꞌai leleleya, ta wate sisidasida Yaubada ꞌena.
Toekalesiyao ꞌidi bubuna
Ta maiboꞌadi Yaubada siꞌamayabena, ta tosimanao ꞌidi guinuwao ꞌebe nuwaowana ta edeedede yaudi siguinuwedi.
Ta toemisao nidi siegogonedima, ta ꞌidi gwegweyao sitagwaledi be ꞌaene tomota maiboꞌadi ꞌidi gwegwe.
Be ꞌeguma ꞌidi ꞌebeloina ꞌasaya simiyami siegimwaneyedi, be yage nidi ꞌadi maisega sieguyaiyedi taudi nigeya ꞌidi gwegwemo ꞌediya.
ꞌEnega ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediya ma idi ꞌatetagwala sitapwatapwalolo Anuwa Tabu ꞌenaya, ta taudi ꞌidi anuwaya ma idi gwausowola siꞌeꞌai egogona,

ta Yaubada situputupu. Ta wate pwalu maiboꞌana toemisao nidi siꞌawa boboꞌanedi. Ga ꞌasiyata ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌediya Yaubada ꞌaina tomota wate ꞌiꞌetoꞌetoseyedi, ga toekalesiyao ꞌadi yau ꞌisinasinabwa.
